tasks.title: Make and review a change
tasks.description: Type something in the editor, then navigate back in time to review a previous version.
tasks.successCriteria: Participant can navigate the timeline and understand version history

tasks.title: Create a branch
tasks.description: Go back to an earlier version and start editing from that point.
tasks.successCriteria: Participant understands branching creates an alternative history

tasks.title: Find your way back
tasks.description: After exploring the timeline, return to the most recent version of your text.
tasks.successCriteria: Participant can orient themselves and navigate to tip of any branch
